description: For each Linear A sign SigLA traces, up to eight of its tracings, by SigLA document and sign position: the site where the sign is most often traced first, nearest the sign's standard form first. An index to SigLA's pages; it holds no image.
rule: Of the tracings SigLA reads with certainty, erased signs left out: the unworn ones of the home site first, those used as a syllable before other uses, by rising distance; then unworn ones of other sites likewise; then worn ones. The home site is the site with the most unworn tracings of the sign as a syllable, or of the sign in any use where it is never a syllable. A tracing is worn where SigLA draws damage dots on it. Distance is the chamfer distance between one-pixel skeletons, scaled into a 64-pixel box, of the tracing without its dots and of the sign as Noto Sans Linear A draws it.
